title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Pikachu?
description:
A former king, a president and King Charles connect Adolf Hitler to Pikachu.

Adolf Hitler → Edward VIII → Richard Nixon → Charles III → Ryan Reynolds → Pikachu

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
